g.text: 面对不同类型的非凸窗口：统一变成“无洞简单边界多边形”再做 atlas

text.style: fill: #4a5568; font: 12.3px 'Microsoft YaHei', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle

g.text: 核心原则：不管原始边界来自折线、圆弧、光滑曲线还是动态形变，优化器最终接收的都是按顺序排列的边界点 vertices。

text.style: fill: #2b6cb0; font: 700 12.2px 'Microsoft YaHei', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle
fill: #1a202c; font: 9px 'Microsoft YaHei', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start
fill: #4a5568; font: 700 12px 'Microsoft YaHei', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle

g.text: 直接 ear clipping 三角剖分

text.style: fill: #2b6cb0; font: 700 12px 'Microsoft YaHei', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle
fill: #2f855a; font: 700 12.2px 'Microsoft YaHei', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle
fill: #1a202c; font: 9px 'Microsoft YaHei', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start
fill: #4a5568; font: 700 12px 'Microsoft YaHei', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle

g.text: 用参数方程或曲线采样
采样点越密越接近真边界
再当作普通多边形处理

text.style: fill: #2f855a; font: 700 12px 'Microsoft YaHei', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle
fill: #6b46c1; font: 700 12.2px 'Microsoft YaHei', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle

g.text: C 星形、齿轮、波浪边界

text.style: fill: #1a202c; font: 9px 'Microsoft YaHei', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start
fill: #4a5568; font: 700 12px 'Microsoft YaHei', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle

g.text: 按角度 θ 采样 r(θ)
适合外边界起伏的窗口

text.style: fill: #6b46c1; font: 700 12px 'Microsoft YaHei', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle
fill: #c05621; font: 700 12.2px 'Microsoft YaHei', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle

g.text: D 直线 + 曲线混合边界

text.style: fill: #1a202c; font: 9px 'Microsoft YaHei', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start
fill: #4a5568; font: 700 12px 'Microsoft YaHei', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle

g.text: 圆弧/贝塞尔段插入采样点
拼成一条闭合有序边界

text.style: fill: #c05621; font: 700 12px 'Microsoft YaHei', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle
fill: #c53030; font: 700 12.2px 'Microsoft YaHei', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle
fill: #1a202c; font: 9px 'Microsoft YaHei', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: 带洞区域 / 自交边界

text.style: fill: #4a5568; font: 700 12px 'Microsoft YaHei', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle

g.text: 或扩展为带洞三角剖分
自交：重新排序或修复边界

text.style: fill: #c53030; font: 700 12px 'Microsoft YaHei', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle

g.text: 必须满足：单条闭合边界
